name: Intelligent Routing
description: Automatic model routing based on task complexity. Classifies incoming messages and routes MEDIUM+ tasks to stronger models, while SIMPLE tasks stay on the default (Haiku).

routerScriptPath.description: Absolute path to intelligent-router-hook.js classifier script

routingLogPath.description: Absolute path to routing-log.jsonl for logging decisions

classifierTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for the classifier subprocess (default: 8000)

enableFastPath.description: Enable keyword-based fast-path for SIMPLE classification (default: true)

dryRun.description: Log routing decisions but don't override the model (default: false)
